questions.prompt: What is the capital city of South Korea?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the South Korea article.

questions.proof: The capital city of South Korea is Seoul.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with South Korea?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture South Korea on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the South Korea article.

questions.proof: In fact, some sources say it is the second most populous after Tokyo, Japan.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of South Korea?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Language” part of the South Korea article.

questions.proof: South Korea's customary and official language is Korean.

questions.prompt: What money is used in South Korea?
